quests.name: A Father's Burden

missions.name: The Birthday Presents
steps: Gather the material Tereban listed. Talk to him about your mission when you have given him everything he was looking for.
You brought all the required materials to Tereban and guaranteed his sons a great birthday party.

missions.name: The Magic Bow - Sinew
steps: Find the wyvern Heoni in the Edron mountains and take his sinew to Tereban.
You delivered Heoni's sinew to Tereban.

missions.name: The Magic Bow - Wood
steps: Find the special wood in the barbarian camps of Hrodmir and bring it to Tereban. It might be a good idea to start looking in the northernmost camp.
You delivered the Wood to Tereban.

missions.name: The Magic Robe - Cloth
steps: Find the spectral cloth hidden deep in the crypts of the isle of the kings and bring it to Tereban. You might have to look for a secret entrance.
You delivered the spectral cloth to Tereban.

missions.name: The Magic Robe - Silk
steps: Find exquisite silk in the spider caves of southern Zao and deliver it to Tereban.
You brought Tereban the required silk.

missions.name: The Magic Rod - Crystal
steps: Find a magic crystal in the tomb buried under the sand east of Ankrahmun and bring it to Tereban.
Tereban received the magic crystal he was looking for.

missions.name: The Magic Rod - Root
steps: Find the mystic root under the city of Banuta and bring it to Tereban.
The magic root was delievered to Tereban.

missions.name: The Magic Shield - Iron
steps: Find some old iron in the mines of Kazordoon for Tereban. Don't get lost - start searching close to the city.
Tereban got the old iron he required.

missions.name: The Magic Shield - Scale
steps: Find the dragon Glitterscale in the caves north of Thais and take its scale to Tereban.
You handed the looted scale to Tereban.

missions.name: The Lost Brother
steps: At the Kha'zeel Mountains you met the merchant Tarun. His brother has gone missing and was last seen following a beautiful woman into a palace. Tarun fears this woman might have been a demon.
You found the remains of Tarun's brother containing a message. Go back to Tarun and report his brother's last words.
You told Tarun about his brother's sad fate. He was very downhearted but gave you his sincere thanks. The beautiful asuri have taken a young man's life and the happiness of another one.

quests.name: Bigfoot's Burden

missions.name: Recruitment: A Test in Gnomology
steps: Pass Gnomerik's test by answering his questions. If you fail to get a high enough score drink a mushroom beer and start again.
You have passed the gnomish psychology test and can proceed to the medical exam. Talk to Gnomespector about your next examination.

missions.name: Recruitment: Ear Examination
steps: You have been g-rayed. It has been an ... unexpected experience. Now you are ready for your ear examination. Walk up to doctor Gnomedix and wait for him to finish your ear examination.
You passed the ear examination. Well, at least most of you did. Now talk to Gnomaticus about your next test.

missions.name: Recruitment: Endurance Test
steps: Enter the lower chamber for your endurance test. Reach the teleporter north of the hall.
You have passed the endurance test. Report back to Gnomewart.
You passed the endurance test and are ready to talk to Gnomelvis about your soul melody.

missions.name: Recruitment: Soul Melody
steps: Find your personal soul melody by trial and error. Create the complete soul melody of seven notes and then report to Gnomelvis. Red notes indicate a failure.
You found your very own soul melody. You should talk to Gnomelvis about it!

missions.name: Daily Minor: Raiders of the Lost Spark
Daily Major: Matchmaker
steps: You have to enter the crystal caves and find a crystal that is fitting the crystal you got from the gnomes. Use the crystal on one of the bigger red crystals in the caves to bond them.
You have finished this quest for now.

missions.name: Daily Major Advanced: Yet Another Grinding
Gnomish War Hero (Warzone 1)
steps: Deliver the Deathstrike's snippet to gnomission to enter the first warzone for free.
You may enter the first warzone without using a mission crystal.

missions.name: Gnomish War Hero (Warzone 2)
steps: Deliver the Gnomevil's hat to gnomission to enter the second warzone for free.
You may enter the second warzone without using a mission crystal.

missions.name: Gnomish War Hero (Warzone 3)
steps: Deliver the Abyssador's lash to gnomission to enter the third warzone for free.
You may enter the third warzone without using a mission crystal.

quests.name: Blood Brothers

missions.name: Mission 01: Gaining Trust
steps: Think of a way to earn Julius' trust and prove that you are not a vampire. Once you thought of something, talk to him again about your mission.
You have Julius' trust.

missions.name: Mission 02: Bad Eggs
steps: Bake garlic cookies by using the garlic dough on a baking tray before you put it on the oven. Hand out cookies to the citizens and watch their reactions. Report any suspicious people to Julius.
You have reported five suspects - probably vamires - to Julius.

missions.name: Mission 03: His True Face
steps: Use the magic words 'alori mort' in front of the suspicious citizens you discovered to hopefully reveal who among them is their leader.
You reported the incident with Armenius to Julius.

missions.name: Mission 04: The Dark Lands
steps: Your task is to find someone to bring you to Vengoth. Explore the island and use Julius' map whenever you find an unusual spot to mark it. Mark at least 5 spots including the castle and report back.

quests.reward: Access to Vengoth including the castle, Vampiric Crest or Yalaharian Outfits addon, 13200 exp (5 times 1000 exp, 1200 exp, 2400 exp and 3600 exp) also a Blood Goblet
quests.dangers: Scorpion, Slime, Tarantula, Haunted Treeling, Demon Skeleton, Vampire, Elder Bonelord, Energy Elemental, Bonelord, Banshee, Bat, Giant Spider, Hellspawn, Nightmare, Nightmare Scion, Nightstalker, Mutated Bat, Poison Spider, Spectre, Werewolf, War Wolf, Vampire, Zombie, Vampire Bride, Fury, Dark Torturer, also few boss monsters like Boreth, Lersatio, Marziel, Arthei and some more

quests.name: Children of the Revolution

missions.name: Prove Your Worzz!
steps: Your Mission is to go to a little camp of lizards at north-east of the Dragonblaze Peaks. You have to find and deliver the Tactical map complete the mission.
You delivered the Tactical map to Zalamon.

missions.name: Mission 1: Corruption
steps: Go to the Temple of Equilibrium (it's marked on your map) and find out what happened there.
The temple has been corrupted and is lost. Zalamon should be informed about this as soon as possible.
You already reported Zalamon about the Temple! Ask him for new mission!

missions.name: Mission 2: Imperial Zzecret Weaponzz
steps: Go into the small camp Chaochai to the north of the Dragonblaze Peaks (Zalamon marks the entrance on your map). There are 3 buildings which you have to spy
You spied 1 of 3 buildings of the camp.
You spied 2 of 3 buildings of the camp.
You spied 3 of 3 buildings of the camp. Zalamon should be informed about this as soon as possible.
You already reported Zalamon about the camp! Ask him for new mission!

missions.name: Mission 3: Zee Killing Fieldzz
steps: Get the poison from Zalamon's storage room. Then go to the teleporter to the Muggy Plains and head east from there to the rice fields. Go to the very top rice field and use the poison anywhere on the water.
The rice has been poisoned. This will weaken the Emperor's army significantly. Return and tell Zalamon about your success.
You already reported Zalamon about your success! Ask him for new mission!

missions.name: Mission 4: Zze Way of Zztonezz
steps: Your mission is to find a way to enter the north of the valley and find a passage to the great gate itself. Search any temples or settlements you come across for hidden passages.
Report Zalamon about the strange symbols that you found.
Get the greasy oil from Zalamon's storage room and put them on the levers that you found.
Due to being extra greasy, the leavers can now be moved.
You found the right combination for the puzzle in the mountains and triggered some kind of mechanism. You should head back to Zalamon to report your success.
You already reported Zalamon about your success! You got a Tome of Knowledge as reward! Ask him for new mission!

missions.name: Mission 5: Phantom Army
steps: Zalamon has sent you on a quest to find out what lies beneath the secret portal in the temple. Find it and explore the other side.
Eternal guardians and lizard chosen has been awaken. Survive them and report it to Zalamon!
You Survived the Waves and reported Zalamon about your success! You got a Serpent Crest as reward!

quests.reward: 10,000 Experience, Tome of Knowledge, Serpent Crest - 2nd addon for Warmaster Outfits, ability to start various tasks
quests.dangers: many High Class Lizards, Killer Caimans, Eternal Guardians, Death Blobs, Mutated Bats, Mutated Tigers

quests.name: Cults of Tibia

missions.name: The Strengthtening of the Minotaurs
steps: Gerimor told you that the naturalist Jamesfrancis is an expert of minotaurs. Right now he is investigating a cave in minocity. But this time something seems to be completely different.
Jamesfrancis already entered the inner part of the cave weeks ago but had to flee when the minotaurs became too strong. He gave you the key to investigate this room as well.
You found an entrance to the minotaur boss. You killed it and now you have to return to Jamesfrancis.
Jamesfrancis sent you to talk with Gerimor about the minotaur cult.
You have reported the Druid of Crunor about the minotaur cult.

missions.name: Patron of Arts
steps: The Druid of Cronor gave you the hint that the Thais exhibition has expanded. The new section is called MOTA (Museum of Tibian Arts). It's really worth a visit.
Gareth told you how to become a patron of the arts. To fulfil your duty you have to manage some tasks. First you have to investigate the crime scene of a theft in the museum.
You found a ransom note, wich requests you to pay some money for the stolen picture to a stonge in Kazordoon. His name is Iwar. Nevertheless I should talk to Gareth first.
You told Gareth about the ransom note. He asked you to pay the money to Iwar to get the picture back. In his opinion, there is no alternative.
You paid the money to stooge in Kazordoon. You were told that the picture is delivered to Gareth himself.
You have to go to Angelo and get a magnifier to investigate all small pictures in the entrance hall of the MOTA. One of them should be a fake.
Angelo allowed you to take a magnifier from a crate next to the cave entrance.
You've fetched the magnifier from Angelo's crate. You're ready for your job in the museum.
Indeed! One of the investigated small pictures is fake. Report to Gareth!
After you told Gareth about the fake painting, he asked you to go to Angelo to get a new picture.
Angelo was not willing to give you a new picture. However, they havent found any artefact in the sandy cave yet. Report to Gareth about your failure.
Even though you weren't successful in getting a replacement for the fake picture, Gareth gave you access to the last floor of the museum. This area is for patrons only.
INTERNAL MESSAGE: THIS NEED QUESTLOG INFORMATION
The Denomintator opened the door for you after you answered his questions to the wanted number. In the end he mentioned the Druid of Conor. Maybe you should pay him a visit.
In the end you told the Druid of Crunor about your experiences in the MoTA.

missions.name: Barkless
steps: The members of the Barkless follow a rigid path of hardship and sacrifice. Their cult is located somewhere beneath Ab'dendriel. Whatever happened to their leader, only a true Barkless can find out.
You survived the sulphur and tar trial. You accepted the stigma of misfortune and vanity. The hardest part, however, is yet to come. Give your life to the ice... to become true and purified.
You broke enough Barkless markings to now reverse the seal held up by the cult object in the ritual chamber. The power you gained feels unnatural and excessive but it seems ther is no other way.
Something far more powerful than the beliel of your Barkless brothers and sisters powered the seal to the leader. Whatever the case - find Leiden, or as he's known to his devotees: the "Penitent".
The Leiden you confronted has strayed far from his own original vision of Barkless. What you encountered was more monster than elf and less virtuous than his devotees would have you believe.
You returned to Gerimor after putting an end to the mischief of Leyden the Penitent. May the Barkless walk the true path again one day.

missions.name: Misguided
steps: ASD
Below a ruin in the vicinity of the outlaw camp east of Thais a strange figure in ragged clothes hinted at something weird going on in a cave. He seemed too confused to decide whether to stop you.
You defeated the cult leader of Misguided by uncovering the true master to pull his strings and freeing this world from its malicious existance. Return to Gerimor to tell him about the victory.
You have spoken to Gerimor about your victory.

missions.name: The Orc Idol
steps: ASD
ASD
You returned to Gerimor after facing the being the orcs worshipped. Whatever it was, it did not find the orcs by accident. A far more powerful force seems to have strategically place it here.

missions.name: The Secret of the Sandy Cave
steps: ASD
ASD
In the cave you haven't found one of the missing scientists. However, you have faced a lots of strange mummies and a green oasis at the end.
After you informed Angelo about your experiences in the cave, he asked you to go back to analyse the water of the oasis. For that reason you got an analysis tool.
You have analysed the water with the help of the analysis tool from Angelo.
You informed Angelo about the analyzed water. He gave you a counteragent, wich you have to apply to the oasis.
You applied the counteragent to the oasis, just like Angelo had asked you to. But the effect was different from what you had expected. A sandstorm approached and caused create damage to the oasis.
You Killed the boss
You reported your victory to Angelo
You have told Gerimor about your stay in the sandy cave. He was not really surprised and felt vindicated that the rumors about a cult in the cave might be true.

missions.name: Zathroth Remmants
steps: ASD
You returned to Gerimor after encounter with the remnants of Zathroth. On one hand its is furtunate that Zathroth indeed wasn't behind all this, but on the other... what is going on there?

missions.name: Dwarves: Home Improvement
steps: You drove off the Lost but more are sure to come. Check back with Klom Stonecutter at a later time.

missions.name: Dwarves: Subterranean Life
steps: You helped Klom defend the outpost by cutting down a number of vermin from deep down below. The gnomes don't seem to completely approve of this but everyone appreciates the drop in the enemy's ranks.

missions.name: Gnomes: Gnomal Warming Measurements
steps: You helped Lardoc Bashsmite fighting back the verminous growth in the northern mineshaft. Return to him later to see if he has more work for you.

missions.name: Gnomes: Ordnance
steps: Gnomus sent you to find and rescue the gnome ordnance the outpost is currently waiting for. Travel to the east of the cave system and find the old gnome trail where reinforcements will arrive.
You helped Lardoc Bashsmite fighting back the verminous growth in the northern mineshaft. Return to him later to see if he has more work for you.

missions.name: Gnomes: Uncharted Territory
steps: You helped Gnomus chart the area around the deep base. You found traces of what could have been an old civilisation but there's not enough left to draw any conclusion.

missions.name: Scouts: Explosive Growth
steps: You helped Lardoc Bashsmite fighting back the verminous growth in the northern mineshaft. Return to him later to see if he has more work for you.

missions.name: Scouts: Pesticide
steps: You reported back to Lardoc Bashsmite to inform him that the gnome's plan to neutralise diremaw corpses seems to work.

missions.name: The Lost Amulet
steps: Mr Morris tasked you to find an ancient amulet that was lost somewhere on Dawnport - probably next to a corpse somewhere.
Come back to Mr Morris.
Mr Morris thanks for you the help.

missions.name: The Stolen Log Book
steps: Mr Morris urged you to find a log book that was stolen by trolls.
Mr Morris thanks you for the help.

missions.name: The Rare Herb
steps: Mr Morris needs the rare Dawnfire herb harvested and brought to him. It grows on gray sand only, he said.
Come back to Mr Morris.
Mr Morris thanks you for the help.

missions.name: The Dorm Key
steps: The key to the adventurer's dormitory has disappeared. Maybe you can find it. Ask around to find out who was the last to have seen it.
Use the fishing rod in the nearby lake to fish Old Nasty.
Come back to Woblin with Old Nasty
Come back to Mr Morris with Key 0010
Mr Morris thanks for the help

steps: Melchior told you the word "Djanni'hah" which can be used to talk to Djinns. Be aware that once you become an ally of one Djinn race, you cannot switch sides anymore.

missions.name: The Marid and the Efreet - Marid Faction
steps: You have joined the Marid. These friendly, blue Djinns are honest and fair allies. You have pledged eternal loyalty to King Gabel and may enter Asha'daramai freely. Djanni'hah!

missions.name: The Efreet and the Efreet - Efreet Faction
steps: You have joined the Efreet. These evil, green Djinns are always up to mischievous pranks. You have pledged eternal loyalty to King Malor and may enter Mal'ouquah freely. Djanni'hah!

quests.name: Forgotten Knowledge

missions.name: Circle of the Black Sphinx
steps: You defeated the rogue Lady Tenebris.

missions.name: Bane of the Cosmic Force
steps: You calmed poor, misguided Lloyd. All he wanted was protection from the outside world. Luckily he seems to have learned his lesson... or has he?

missions.name: The Desecrated Glade
steps: You defeated the Thorn Knight and shattered the root of evil with all your might. The honor of being a guardian of the glade indeed comes with pride as well as responsibility.

missions.name: The Unwary Mage
steps: With help of Ivalisse from the temple of the Astral Shapers in Thais and her father, you averted the Dragon King's menace deep in the Zao Muggy Plains.

missions.name: Dragon in Distress
steps: You saved the Dragon Mother's egg and she melted the ice wall that blocked your way.

missions.name: Time is a Window
steps: You defeated the Time Guardian and are free to return to your own time. For some creatures in this world, it seems neither past nor future are an obstacle.

missions.name: Final Fight
steps: Description Fault.

You received Brewster's prayer: "Your hand shall be guided - your feet shall walk in harmony". Now, bring your stake to Tyrias in Liberty Bay for the next line of the prayer.
You received Tyrias' prayer: "Your mind shall be a vessel for joy, light and wisdom". He wasn't exactly happy though and said that if you need some mumbo jumbo again, you should rather go to Chondur.

missions.name: Joining the Explorers
steps: The mission should be simple to fulfil. You have to seek out Uzgod in Kazordoon and get the pickaxe for us. Or just find dwarven pickaxe on your own...
Get into Dwacatra and get Uzgod's family brooch.
Bring family brooch back to Uzgod
Bring the pickaxe back to the Explorer Society representative.
You have completed Joining the Explorers

missions.name: The Ice Delivery
steps: Take this ice pick and use it on a block of ice in the caves beneath Folda. Get some ice and bring it here as fast as you can. If the ice melt away, report on your ice delivery mission anyway.
You have 10 minutes before the icicle defrosts. Run back to the Explorer Society representative!
You have completed The Ice Delivery.

missions.name: The Butterfly Hunt
steps: This preparation kit will allow you to collect a PURPLE butterfly you have killed. Just use it on the fresh corpse of a PURPLE butterfly.
Return the prepared butterfly to Explorer Society representative.
Ask for another butterfly hunt.
This preparation kit will allow you to collect a BLUE butterfly you have killed. Just use it on the fresh corpse of a BLUE butterfly.
Return the prepared butterfly to Explorer Society representative.
Ask for another butterfly hunt.
This preparation kit will allow you to collect a RED butterfly you have killed. Just use it on the fresh corpse of a RED butterfly.
Return the prepared butterfly to Explorer Society representative.
You have completed The Butterfly Hunt.

missions.name: The Plant Collection
steps: Take botanist's container. Use it on a jungle bells plant to collect a sample.
Report about your plant collection to Explorer Society representative.
Ask for plant collection when you are ready to continue.
Use botanist's container on a witches cauldron to collect a sample.
Report about your plant collection to Explorer Society representative.
Ask for plant collection when you are ready to continue.
Use this botanist's container on a giant jungle rose to obtain a sample.
Report about your plant collection to Explorer Society representative.
You have completed The Plant Collection.

missions.name: The Lizard Urn
steps: In the south-east of Tiquanda is a small settlement of the lizard people. Beneath the newly constructed temple there, the lizards hide the urn. Acquire an ancient urn which is some sort of relic to the lizard people of Tiquanda.
Bring the Funeral Urn back to the Explorer Society.
You have completed The Lizard Urn.

missions.name: The Bonelord Secret
steps: Travel to the city of Darashia and then head north-east for the pyramid. If any documents are left, you probably find them in the catacombs beneath.
Bring the Wrinkled Parchment back to the Explorer Society representative.
You have completed The Bonelord Secret.

missions.name: The Orc Powder
steps: As far as we can tell, the orcs maintain some sort of training facility in some hill in the north-east of their city. There you should find lots of their war wolves and hopefully also some of the orcish powder.
Bring the Strange Powder to the Explorer Society representative to complete your mission.
You have completed The Orc Powder.

missions.name: The Elven Poetry
steps: This mission is easy but nonetheless vital. Travel Hellgate beneath Ab'Dendriel and get the book.
Bring back an elven poetry book to the Explorer Society representative.
You have completed The Elven Poetry.

missions.name: The Memory Stone
steps: In the ruins of north-western Edron you should be able to find a memory stone.
Bring back a memory stone to the Explorer Society representative.
You have completed The Memory Stone.

missions.name: The Rune Writings
steps: Somewhere under the ape infested city of Banuta, one can find dungeons that were once inhabited by lizards. Look there for an atypical structure that would rather fit to Ankrahmun and its Ankrahmun Tombs. Copy the runes you will find on this structure.
Report back to the Explorer Society representative.
You have completed The Rune Writings.

missions.name: The Ectoplasm
steps: Take ectoplasm container and use it on a ghost that was recently slain.
Return back to the Explorer Society representative with the collected ectoplasm.

missions.name: The Spectral Dress
steps: The queen of the banshees lives in the so called Ghostlands, south west of Carlin. Try to get a spectral dress from her.
Report to the Explorer Society with the spectral dress.

missions.name: The Spectral Stone
steps: Please travel to our second base and ask them to mail us their latest research reports. Then return here and ask about new missions.
Tell our fellow explorer that the papers are in the mail already.
Take the spectral essence and use it on the strange carving in this building as well as on the corresponding tile in our second base.
Good! Now use the spectral essence on the strange carving in our second base.

missions.name: The Astral Portals
steps: Both carvings are now charged and harmonised. You are able to travel in zero time from one base to the other, but you need to have an orichalcum pearl in your possession to use it as power source.

missions.name: The Island of Dragons
steps: Travel to Okolnir and try to find a proof for the existence of dragon lords there in the old times. I think old Buddel might be able to bring you there.
Report back to Lurik with the dragon scale.

missions.name: The Ice Music
steps: There is a cave on Hrodmir, north of the southernmost barbarian camp Krimhorn. In this cave, there are a waterfall and a lot of stalagmites. Take the resonance crystal and use it on the stalagmites in the cave to record the sound of the wind.
Report back to Lurik.
Now you may use the Astral Bridge from Liberty Bay to Svargrond.

missions.name: The Undersea Kingdom
steps: Captain Max will bring you to Calassa whenever you are ready. Please try to retrieve the missing logbook which must be in one of the sunken shipwrecks.
Report about your Calassa mission to Berenice in Liberty Bay.
Congratulations, you completed the remaining part of this mission!

quests.location: Begins in Port Hope or Northport, but requires travel throughout Tibia
quests.reward: Ice Pick, Spectral Stone, 6 Orichalcum Pearls, 1 Crown Backpack, 5250 gp, the ability to buy Atlases, Orichalcum Pearls and Crown Backpacks. You can use the teleporters between Port Hope and Northport, and between Liberty Bay and Svargrond which works having an Orichalcum Pearl. You have the ability to travel to Calassa and the Frozen Trench, and hunt underwater. You will also receive the achievements Just in Time (if the further requirements are met), Explorer and Sea Scout
quests.dangers: From Rats, Dwarves, all kinds of Orcs, all kinds of Minotaurs, all kinds of Lizards, all kinds of Apes, Priestesses, Demon Skeletons, all kinds of Humans, all kinds of Elves, and all kinds of Undead, until Frost Dragons and all kinds of Quara

quests.name: The First Dragon
quests.reward: Festive Outfits, a Porcelain Mask, 3 Colourful Feathers and a backpack containing, 3 Gold Tokens an Ancient Coin, Draken Sulphur, 2 Seacrest Hair, 2 Mystical Hourglass, a Blue Gem, a Red Gem, a Yellow Gem, 2 Demon Horns, 2 Slime Hearts, 2 Energy Veins, 2 Petrified Screams, 2 Brimstone Shells, 2 Deepling Warts, 2 Wyrm Scales and 2 Hellspawn Tails
quests.dangers: A variety of Dragons, Kalyassa, Gelidrazah the Frozen, Tazhadur, Zorvorax, and The First Dragon

quests.name: The Gravedigger of Drefia Quest
quests.reward: 2 Small Emeralds, 2 Small Rubies, 3 Black Pearls, 1500 exp, Nail Case (used for Hellgrip mount)
quests.dangers: Necromancers, Priestesses, Gravediggers, Blood Hands, Blood Priests, White Shades, Liches, Banshees, Shadow Pupils, Vampires, Vampire Brides, Vampire Viscounts, Zombies and lesser creatures of Drefia. Also possible to face Arachir the Ancient One or Gravelord Oshuran

quests.name: The Great Dragon Hunt Quest
quests.reward: Red Dragon Scale once, and one of the following every time you complete the quest: 5 Platinum Coins, a Small Ruby + a Small Emerald + a Small Sapphire, a Life Ring, a Red Gem, 10 Strong Mana Potions or 8 Strong Health Potions. Upon completing the quest 10 times, the achievement Hoard of the Dragon will be awarded
quests.dangers: Dragons, Dragon Lord, Dragon Hatchling, Dragon Lord Hatchling

quests.name: The Hidden City of Beregar

missions.name: Going Down
steps: Deliver 3 Gear Wheels to Xorlosh.
You sucessfully helped Xorlosh in repairing the elevator. You can now enter the teleporter to the eastern part of the mine.

missions.name: Justice for All
steps: Nokmir told you that he is falsely accused of being a thief. You could help him by talking to Grombur about the case. Furthermore you should try to find that ring which belongs to Rerun.
You should talking to Grombur about Nokmir.
You should try to find that ring which belongs to Rerun everywhere in the mine.
You have found Rerun's ring. Bring the ring to the emperor Rehal and talk to him about Nokmir.
You informed emperor Rehal about your recent discoveries and he acquitted Nokmir of being a thief.
You told Nokmir about his acquittal and he granted you access to the northern mine.

missions.name: Pythius the Rotten
steps: You won the battle against the malicious undead dragon Pythius the Rotten. He granted you firewalker boots as a reward.

missions.name: Sweet as Chocolate Cake
steps: Bake a Chocolate Cake and bring it to Bolfona at the bar.
Report back to Frafnar by telling him about the mission.
You told Frafnar that you did everything he asked you to do. You may now enter the western part of the mine.

missions.name: The Good Guard
steps: Grombur asked you to get him a cask of dwarven brown ale. You heard that Boozer in Venore tried to brew some. Maybe you should pay him a visit.
Grombur liked the ale and you are now allowed to enter his part of the mine.

quests.location: Beregar, Fenrock, Mistrock, Ab'dendriel, Yalahar, Venore, Kazordoon
quests.reward: Access to the Beregar Mines, Rusted Armor, Gold Ingot, 3 Small Topaz, Crystal of Focus, Firewalker Boots, 10 Brown Mushrooms, Dwarven Legs and the ability to buy Rust Remover
quests.dangers: Rotworm, Carrion Worm, Tortoise, Crocodile, Bat, Centipede, Skeleton, Skeleton Warrior, all Goblins, Stone Golem, Dwarf, Dwarf Soldier, Dwarf Guard, Dwarf Geomancer, Pythius The Rotten (subquest)., If you get lost: Warlock, Diabolic Imp, Wyrm, Wyvern, Dragon, Dragon Lord, Lich, Bonebeast, Elder Bonelord, Bonelord, Necromancer, Fire Devil, Fire Elemental, Spider, Poison Spider, Tarantula, Giant Spider, Scarab, Ancient Scarab., Royal Rescue mission: Furious Troll, Troll Legionnaire, Mechanical Fighter, Stone Golem, Gozzler, Zombie, Orc Berserker
quests.aka: Dwarven Quest, Royal Rescue Quest, Firewalker Boots Quest, Hidden City of Beregar Quest, Beregar Quest, Quest of the Boots of Walking on Fire

quests.name: The Hunt for the Sea Serpent Quest
quests.reward: Access to Sea Serpent Spawns
quests.dangers: Deepsea Blood Crab, Young Sea Serpent, Sea Serpent

quests.name: The Ice Islands Quest

missions.name: Befriending the Musher
steps: Find Sniffler the husky of Iskan. He should be somewhere north west of the town. He is probably marking his territory so you should be able to find his trace. Call him sniffler and feed him with meat.
Tell Iskan that you found and feed Sniffler
You are now a friend of Iskan and can ask him for a passage to Nibelor. You should ask Hjaern in Nibelor if you can help him.

missions.name: Nibelor 1: Breaking the Ice
steps: Chakoyas may use the ice for a passage to the west and attack Svargrond. Use the rocks at east of nibelor on at least three of these places and the chakoyas probably won't be able to pass the ice.
You have broke 1 of 3 icepassages
You have broke 2 of 3 icepassages
You have broke 3 of 3 icepassages! Tell Hjaern your mission!
You should ask Silfind if you can help her in some matters.

missions.name: Nibelor 2: Ecological Terrorism
steps: Siflind send you to travel to a distant land to get ants from an Ant-Hill to perform ecological terrorism on some pirates on Tyrsung. Just use the jug on an anthill.

Now head back to Svargrond and go to Buddel, the drunk sailor in southern Svargrond, and ask him to take you to Tyrsung. Now go all the way to the southern shores where you find a outpost. Go to the bottom deck and use the jug with the western mast
Go tell Siflind that you released the ants and aks her for mission!

missions.name: Nibelor 3: Artful Sabotage
steps: Siflind gave you a Vial of Paint to use on some Baby Seals. Go back to Tyrsung and follow the shore from Buddel south. Use the Vial of Paint on three of these seals.
Go tell Siflind that you painted the seals and aks her for mission!

missions.name: Nibelor 4: Berserk Brewery
steps: The first things needed are 5 bat wings to brew a berserker elixir. Bring her them!
The next items Siflind need are 4 bear paws. Bring her them!
The next items Siflind need are 3 bonelord eyes. Bring her them!
The next items Siflind need are 2 fish fins. Bring her them!
The next item Siflind need is a green dragon scale. Bring her that!
You helped Siflind to defend Svargrond. Now Nilsor need help, go ask him for mission.

missions.name: Nibelor 5: Cure the Dogs
steps: To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 1st of 7 ingredients: a Part of the Sun Adorer Cactus. Only an ordinary kitchen knife will be precise enough to produce the ingredient weneed.
To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 2nd of 7 ingredients: Geyser Water in a Waterskin. Use it on a geyser that is NOT active. The water of active geysers is far too hot.
To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 3rd of 7 ingredients: Fine Sulphur. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on an inactive lava hole.
To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 4th of 7 ingredients: the Frostbite Herb. You can find it on mountain peaks. You will need to cut it with a fine kitchen knife.

To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 5th of 7 ingredients: Purple Kiss Blossom. The purple kiss is a plant that grows in a place called jungle. You will have to use a kitchen knife to harvest its blossom.
To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 6th of 7 ingredients: the Hydra Tongue. The hydra tongue is a common pest plant in warmer regions. You might find one in a shop.

To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 7th of 7 ingredients: Spores of a Giant Glimmercap Mushroom. The giant glimmercap mushroom exists in caves and other preferably warm and humid places. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on a mushroom to collectits spores.
You found all ingredients to cure Nilsor dogs, ask him for mission. You can now travel by Dog Sleds to Inukaya.

missions.name: The Secret of Helheim
steps: Hjaern might have a mission for you. So maybe you go and talk to him.
Hjaern send you to find someone in Svargrond who can give you a passage to Helheim and seek the reason for the unrest there.
You discovered the necromantic altar and should report Hjaern about it.

missions.name: The Contact
steps: Get out of Nibelor and go to the Svargrond Explorer's Society. Ask Lurik for the mission.
Get to the raider camp, then follow to the extreme south where you find lots of barbarians. Near the southern most coastline, try looking for the NPC Nor. Ask him about Memory Crystal.
Go back to Lurik and deliver him the memory crystal.
Give Lurik some time to evaluate the information (ca. 5min). Then talk to him again about your mission.

missions.name: Formorgar Mines 1: The Mission
steps: Find the entrance of the Formorgar Mines. Find some hint or someone who is willing to talk about what is going on there.
You found a old and tattered written paper in a skeleton next to a Restless Soul, you can only make out a signature: Tylaf, apprentice of Hjaern. Ask Hjaern about Tylaf.

missions.name: Formorgar Mines 2: Ghostwhisperer
steps: Go back to the mine and ask the restless soul about his story.
You already have listen to his story!

missions.name: Formorgar Mines 3: The Secret
steps: The Cultists plan is to create a new demon army for their master to conquer the world. Hjaern and the other shamans must learn about it! Hurry before its too late.
The Cultists plan is to create a new demon army for their master to conquer the world. Hjaern and the other shamans are already informed!

missions.name: Formorgar Mines 4: Retaliation
steps: Hjaern gave you a spirit charm of cold. Travel to the mines and find four special obelisks to mark them with the charm.
1 of 4 obelisks are marked.
2 of 4 obelisks are marked.
3 of 4 obelisks are marked.
Once all 4 obelisks are marked report back to Hjaern.
You got the Norseman outfit and you have access to the Yakchal room deep in the Formorgar Mines.

missions.name: Barbarian Test 1: Barbarian Booze
steps: You participate in the drinking challenge. Now you can get the permission for a few sips of barbarian mead in exchange for some honey.
Now drink from the bucket until you drink 10 sips in a row without passing out
You have mastered the first task of the barbarian test. If you haven't done so yet, talk to Sven about it.

missions.name: Barbarian Test 2: The Bear Hugging
steps: Somewhere north of Svargrond you will find a lonely bear which you have to hug. You wonder what you were thinking when accepting this quest...
You passed the bear hugging test (and should take a bath). If you haven't done so yet, talk to Sven about it.

missions.name: Barbarian Test 3: The Mammoth Pushing
steps: Find a mammoth north-west of Svargrond and knock it over. You wonder whether your mission is becoming a barbarian or rather commiting suicide.
You have knocked over a mammoth - though you wonder what this crushing noise at your spine was. If you haven't done so yet, talk to Sven about the mammoth pushing.

missions.name: The Honorary Barbarian
steps: You are now a honorary barbarian and can become a citizen of Svargrond. If you haven't done so yet, you should look for a barbarian in need of help in the north of the town.

quests.reward: Norseman Outfit, access to the Formorgar Mines, Helheim, Tyrsung, ability to use the dogsleds from Nibelor to Inukaya, ability to become a citizen of Svargrond, including talking to the arena, boat and more NPCs
quests.dangers: All ice islands creature, the cultists, and eventually a lot of demonic creatures
quests.aka: Svargrond Quest, Snow Quest, Nordic Shaman Quest

quests.name: The Inquisition

missions.name: Mission 1: Interrogation
steps: Your mission is to investigate the 5 guards in Thais regarding the Heretic behavior. Tim, Kulag, Grof, Miles and Walter are their names. If you do well you see a holy sprite on you.
You investigated 1 of 5 guards in Thais.
You investigated 2 of 5 guards in Thais.
You investigated 3 of 5 guards in Thais.
You investigated 4 of 5 guards in Thais.
You investigated 5 of 5 guards in Thais. Get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.
You investigated all guards in Thais.

missions.name: Mission 2: Eclipse
steps: Henricus tells you to get The Witches' Grimoire, he sends you to Femor Hills where you can fly to the witches' mountain, say Eclipse to Uzon and he will take you there. Use the vial of holy water that he gives you on the big cauldron and open the chest to your left, then bring the witches' grimoire to Henricus.
Find the witches' grimoire and bring it to Henricus.
You already brought the witches' grimoire to Henricus.

missions.name: Mission 3: Vampire Hunt
steps: Henricus wants you to find the Dwarfish Vampire Hunter, Storkus, located west of the Dwarf Bridge. It's good idea bring your 20 Vampire Dusts with you to save some time.
Go Back to Storkus the Dwarf and ask for Mission.

Now Storkus wants you to kill a vampire lord, The Count in the Green Claw Swamp, The Count is located near to the Blood Herb Quest. To summon The Count, you must use the coffin in the center of the room. Kill it and bring The Ring of the Count to Storkus.
Kill The Count and bring his ring to Storkus the Dwarf and ask for Mission.
Return to Henricus and tell him that you finished your job here.
Get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.

missions.name: Mission 4: The Haunted Ruin
steps: Henricus will gave you a Special Flask (vial of holy water). Go to Liberty Bay and use the vial on an old house. Use this vial of holy water on that spot to drive out the evil being.
Kill the Pirate Ghost and get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.
You already cleaned the abandoned and haunted house in Liberty, ask Henricus for mission.

missions.name: Mission 5: Essential Gathering
steps: Henricus wants 20 Demonic Essences as a proof of your accomplishments.
Now ask Henricus for outfit to get the Demon Hunter Outfit.
You got the Demon Hunter Outfit! Ask Henricus for mission to unlock more addons.

missions.name: Mission 6: The Demon Ungreez
steps: Henricus wants you to kill a demon called Ungreez. Head to Edron Hero Cave and go down a few levels.
You killed Ungreez, report your mission to Henricus.
You got the the first addon of Demon Hunter Outfit! Ask Henricus for mission to unlock more addons.

missions.name: Mission 7: The Shadow Nexus
steps: Your mission is to go to the Demon Forge and slay seven of The Ruthless Seven Minions. The Demon Forge is located in the Edron Hero Cave, through a portal after the Vampire Shield Quest.
You destroyed the shadow nexus! Get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.
Now ask to Henricus for a outfit. He will give you the 2nd addon of the Demon Hunter Outfits.
You got the the second addon of Demon Hunter Outfit! Go now to the reward room and choose one wisely!
You have completed The Inquisition Quest! You can now buy the Blessing of the Inquisition!

quests.reward: Demon Hunter Outfit and addons Image:Outfit Demon Hunter Male Addon 3.gif Image:Outfit Demon Hunter Female Addon 3.gif, access to the deeper Demon Forge areas, ability to buy the Blessing of the Inquisition, 3 achievements (High Inquisitor, Master of the Nexus and Demonbane), and your choice of one of the following: Emerald Sword, Hellforged Axe, Obsidian Truncheon, Warsinger Bow, Royal Crossbow, Spellbook of Dark Mysteries, Master Archer's Armor, Fireborn Giant Armor, Robe of the Underworld or Merudri Nanbando
quests.dangers: Juggernauts, Lost Souls, Dark Torturers, Demons, Behemoths, Hellfire Fighters, Undead Dragons, Hellhounds, Massive Water Elementals, Quara Predators, Quara Pinchers, Quara Hydromancers, Hands of Cursed Fate, Massive Fire Elementals, Crystal Spiders, Nightmares, Giant Spiders and more monsters. Additionally, the bosses The Count, Ungreez, Ushuriel, Madareth, Golgordan and Latrivan, Annihilon, Zugurosh, and Hellgorak

quests.name: The Lost Brother Quest
quests.reward: 3000 experience points, ability to trade with Tarun, a Red Gem, and the achievement Lost Palace Raider (if the further requirements are met)
quests.dangers: Hellspawns, Dawnfire Asuri, Midnight Asuri, Frost Flower Asuri, Greater Fire Elementals

quests.name: The New Frontier

missions.name: Mission 01: New Land
steps: Explore the new land and reach the bottom of the mountain.
You have found a passage from the mountains. You can report back to Ongulf.
You have reported the scouted route to Ongulf.

missions.name: Mission 02: From Kazordoon With Love
steps: Find Melfar of the imperial mining guild close to a mine entrance west of Kazordoon. Ask him to send more miners and wood.
Prepare the three trees which Melfar marked on your map with the beaver bait. Once you've marked all three return to Melfar and tell him about your success.
Melfar has finally promised to send more miners and wood. Report this to Ongulf in Farmine.
You have reported that Melfar will send more miners and wood for Farmine.

missions.name: Mission 03: Strangers in the Night
steps: Find the unknown stalkers somewhere in the mountains. They apparently climbed up somewhere during their escape. Try to negotiate a peaceful agreement if possible.
You have talked to the leader of the primitive humans and have assured their peacefulness. Report this to Ongulf back in the base.
You have negotiated a peacful agreement between the dwarfs and the local primitives.

missions.name: Mission 04: The Mine Is Mine
steps: Free the mine of the monstrous threat. Use a lift to reach the mines and look for a leader of the stone creatures. Slay this creature and report back to Ongulf.
You have slain the monster that terrorised the mines.

missions.name: Mission 05: Getting Things Busy
steps: Try getting the support of the people mentioned. Talk to them about "farmine", then choose the "flatter", "threaten", "impress", "bluff", "reason" or "plea" and report any progress to Ongulf.
You have gained the necessary support for Farmine.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of Kazordoon's Worm Tamer
steps: Talk to the worm tamer in Kazordoon.
Find an item that interests Humgolf to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of the Edron Academy
steps: Talk to the magician Wyrdin in the Edron Academy.
Find an item that interests Wyrdin to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of the Explorer Society
steps: Talk to the representative of the Explorer Society in Port Hope.
Find an item that interests Angus to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of the Inventor Telas
steps: Talk to the inventor Telas in Edron.
Find an item that interests Telas to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of the Thaian King
steps: Talk to King Tibianus in the Thaian Castle.
Find an item that interests King Tibianus to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 5: Support of the Venorean Traders
steps: Talk to Leeland Slim, the representative of the Venorean Traders.
Find an item that interests Leeland Slim to get another chance.

missions.name: Mission 06: Days Of Doom
steps: Try to pacify the orcs of the steppe. It is probably necessary to find some leader of the orcish tribes.
You have talked to the minotaur leaders of the orcs. They agreed to spare Farmine if you prove your worth in their arena. You will have to survive against Mooh'Tah master for 2 minutes, so prepare!
You have survived the arena. Talk to Curos again about your mission.
Your negotiations had moderate success. Your can report back to Ongulf.
You have ensured a brittle peace between Farmine and the orcs.

missions.name: Mission 07: Messengers Of Peace
steps: Find a lizardman somewhere in the north and try to start a negotiation of peace.
It seems that the lizardmen are not interested in peace and you will have to focus on other problems at hand.

missions.name: Mission 08: An Offer You Can't Refuse
steps: Captured by lizardmen trap you have to find a way out of the prison. Perhaps something in your cell might lead you to an opportunity for freedom.
You managed to find a way of the captivity of the lizardmen - but for a price.

missions.name: Mission 09: Mortal Combat
steps: You are expected to participate in the great tournament of the lizard race. Travel to the Isle of Strife and brave the challenges there.
You are the champion of the great tournament! Still the lizardmen are a menace to behold. You should report to Chrak before you leave the isle.
You have reported your latest doings to Chrak. It seems you bought the dwarfs some time of peace. Only the dragon kings may know how long though.

missions.name: Mission 10: New Horizons
steps: Ongulf will be anxious to learn about your latest adventures. Travel back to Farmine for a final report.
Ongulf got very satisfied with your journey, this land is yours to be taken. You can find now on top of the mountain a red carpet, it might offer you access to some cities.

missions.name: Tome of Knowledge Counter
steps: You brought the fist Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the lizard culture. Pompan will sell you dragon tapestries from now on.
You brought the second Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the minotaur culture. Pompan will sell you minotaur backpacks from now on.
You brought the third Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the last stand of the draken culture. Esrik will sell you lizard weapon rack from now on.

You brought the fourth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something interesting about a certain food that the lizardmen apparently prepare. Swolt will trade you a bunch of ripe rice for 10 rice balls from now on.
You brought the fifth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the last stand of the lizards in the South, Zzaion. Pompan will sell you lizard backpacks from now on.
You brought the sixth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt a few things about the primitive human culture on this continent. Cael will sell you War Drums and Didgeridoo from now on.
You brought the seventh Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something interesting about the Zao steppe. Now you to use the snake teleport at the peak of the mountain.
You brought the eighth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt a few things about an illness. Now you can enter a corruption hole in the north-eastern end of Zao.
You brought the ninth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something interesting about the Draken origin. Esrik will buy lizard equipment from you now.

You brought the tenth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the last stand of the lizard dynasty. Now you can enter the Zao Palace. It is situated deep underground, below the mountain base of the Lizards.
You brought the eleventh Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something interesting about dragons and their symbolism. You can buy a Dragon Statue from NPC Cael after you bring him a Red Lantern.

You brought the twelfth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something about reveals some of the power structures in Zao. Cael will now make a Dragon Throne for you after you bring him a Red Piece of Cloth. He will reward you with 5000 experience points for each extra tome you give to him.

quests.reward: Tome of Knowledge, Piggy Bank, 2 Gold Ingots, Bullseye Potion, Mastermind Potion and Berserk Potion, access to the southern and central parts of Zao, base Warmaster Outfit File:Outfit Warmaster Male.gif File:Outfit Warmaster Female.gif

quests.name: The Rookie Guard

missions.name: Mission 01: A Taste of Things to Come
Mission 02: Defence!
steps: Vascalir promised you some equipment, but first you need to build up some muscles. Find a big pile of stone in a barn to the north and use it to get a heavy stone.
You retrieved one stone from the big pile. Climb onto the roof of either Norma's bar, Obi's shop or the academy to find a catapult to use it on.
You loaded a stone on one of the catapults. One more to go! Climb onto the roof of either Norma's bar, Obi's shop or the academy to find a catapult to load with a heavy stone.
Two of the four catapults on the roofs are loaded. That should be enough to build up a decent defence. Return to Vascalir to turn in your quest.
You made sure that Rookgaard's defences are at their best. If the orcs try to enter the village, they won't have an easy time!

missions.name: Mission 04: Home-Brewed
steps: Vascalir doesn't have a job for you at the moment. He sent you to Lily in the south-west of town for another mission.
Lily gave you a bag with fresh herbs that need to be delivered to Hyacinth outside of the village. Leave the village to the north and walk east to find his little hut up a mountain.
You've delivered the fresh herbs to Hyacinth. He still has a reward for you though - make sure to talk to him again!
Hyacinth has another reward for you - make sure to talk to him again with enough space in your inventory.
You've delivered the herbs to Hyacinth and got potions and a ring as reward. Save the potions for when you're low on health and wear the ring if you want to regain health faster. Return to Vascalir.
You've told Vascalir about your successful delivery. The next mission awaits.

missions.name: Mission 05: Web of Terror
steps: Vascalir sent you to the spider queen's lair to retrieve a web sample. Leave the village to the north and cross the bridge to the north-west to find the lair. Look for greasy blue stones.
You've covered yourself in grease. It's a bit disgusting, but the spider queen will not be able to smell you for about two minutes. Enter her cave and USE an intact spider web to retrieve a sample.
You retrieved some of the spider queen's web. Return to Vascalir and try not to get caught by the queen on the way out!
The spider queen caught you in her net. If you had a sample of her web, you've lost it. Find a way out of her net and retry!
Vascalir took the sample from you. He still has a studded armor for you - talk to him once you have enough space in your inventory.
You've brought the spider queen's web back to Vascalir. This will definitely come in handy later on.

missions.name: Mission 06: Run Like a Wolf
steps: Vascalir sent you to Tom the Tanner, who can be found to the west of the academy. There you will get your next mission.
Leave the village to the north and walk north-east into the forest to find the wolves' den that Tom told you about. Hopefully you will find that poacher to take some leather from him!
You've entered the wolves' den - that was a one-way fall, but luckily you didn't get hurt. The poacher you were looking for is dead - but that doesn't mean you can't get some war wolf leather!
You've skinned a war wolf - but you alerted the wolf pack! Run to the exit, quickly!
RUN! You have only a limited time to reach the exit with the war wolf leather!
Phew - you managed to get out of the wolves' den in time. Return to Tom to finish your mission.
Tom gave you a pair of leather boots as reward for your good work. Vascalir surely has a new mission for you now.

missions.name: Mission 07: Attack!
steps: While you were gone, trolls have infiltrated the academy and set it on fire! Enter the burning vault deep underground and try to recover the copy of the book of orc language before it's destroyed.
You've done all you could - but unfortunately the book is lost. No need to lose heart though - there is still hidden knowledge about the orc language in the village, and the next mission awaits.

missions.name: Mission 08: Less Risk - More Fun
steps: Before getting revenge on the trolls, eliminate the risk of losing money on the way. Paulie has an interesting bonus offer for you if you deposit your money at the bank. Find him below the academy.
You've done as Vascalir asked and talked to Paulie. Remember to always leave your gold on your account! That way there's no risk of losing it.

missions.name: Mission 09: Rock 'n Troll
steps: Enter the troll lair to the north of the village and find the new tunnel which the trolls dug and used to infiltrate the Rookgaard academy. There, you need to find a way to destroy it.
Open the chests in the tunnel and use the pick on the 5 beams to weaken the structure and make the tunnel collapse.
You've weakened one of five beams.
You've weakened two of five beams.
You've weakened three of five beams.
You've weakened four of five beams.
You've weakened all the beams! Hurry out of the tunnel before it collapses!
The tunnel collapsed behind you. Time to return to Vascalir.
Vascalir rewarded you with experience, but there's still something he has to give you. You should talk to him again.
The trolls will not be able to enter the academy via their tunnel again. The village is safe for now - at least from trolls.

missions.name: Mission 10: Tomb Raiding
steps: Leave the village to the north and walk south-east to find the haunted graveyard. Descend into the crypt and find a sarcophagus that might still contain a fleshy bone. Bring it to Vascalir.
You've brought the fleshy bone back to Vascalir. Talk to him again to receive your reward.
You managed to get a fleshy bone from the crypt! Who knows what Vascalir plans with it - but this is going to be good.

missions.name: Mission 11: Sweet Poison
steps: Leave the village to the north and cross the bridge to the west, then walk south-west to find a wasp lair. Make sure you don't lose the flask Vascalir gave you.
You've found the wasp lair. Kill one wasp and use the empty flask on its dead body to retrieve some of its poison.
You've retrieved some lethal wasp poison. Bring it back to Vascalir to complete the mission.
You brought Vascalir the highly toxic poison. You should talk to him again to receive your reward.
You've retrieved highly toxic wasp poison for Vascalir. It's time for your final challenge.

missions.name: Mission 12: Into The Fortress
steps: This is it - the infiltration of the orc fortress and revenge on Kraknaknork awaits. Get the required items from a chest in the academy near the bank.
You've got all items you need to finally kill Kraknaknork. Don't lose them, and carefully make your way towards the orc fortress located in the far west of Rookgaard. Leave the village to the north.
You've knocked out the unsuspecting orc. USE the orc before it wakes up again to disguise yourself as an orc!
Even your mom wouldn't recognise you. You might not be able to fool all orcs in your disguise, but it should be enough to walk past the orc guarding the entrance.
You managed to sneak into the fortress. Use the fleshy bone and click on the elite orc guard with the crosshairs to create a distraction!
The guard is indeed very distracted - he smells delicious. At least to the wild dogs that entered the scene. This is the perfect time to enter the lower levels of the orc fortress.
You're inside the orc fortress! Now you need to find a kitchen and something that looks like a soup cauldron. Use the wasp poison on the cauldron to create an evil surprise for Kraknaknork.
You "spiced up" Kraknaknork's breakfast. Let's see how strong he still is after his meal. Proceed further into the fortress - and keep your tarantula trap ready.
You managed to slow down the furious orc berserker. Now, run through the teleporter while he isn't close to it!
You've entered Kraknaknork's room. Find a way to get rid of the energy barriers.
You solved the riddle of the energy barriers. The way to the throne room should be clear - for a short time. Be prepared for a massive fight!
You've entered Kraknaknork's throne room. Fight him! You can back out at any time via the teleporter, but you'll have to start the battle over. Once he is dead, enter the teleporter near his throne.
You've vanquished Kraknaknork and found his treasure room. You can probably take a few things from there before you leave - he wouldn't care anymore.
With the last bit of Kraknaknork's energy, you were teleported out of the fortress. Time to return to Vascalir victoriously.
You've vanquished Kraknaknork and brought peace to the village of Rookgaard. It will soon be time for you to leave for the Isle of Destiny, choose a vocation and enter the open world of Tibia.

You got stucked on this island. You must discover how to leave.
You successfully built a raft and used the starts to navigate your way through the waves. At least you found something of interest on the deserted island.
Congratulations you completed this mission.

missions.name: Liquid Death
steps: Dedoras has sent you to Spectulus in the Edron Academy. Rumors of strange fishmen in the Tiquanda region may be connected to some of the research the scholar conducted.
Spectulus asked you to check out the rumors of strange fishmen in the jungles of northern Tiquanda. A small sunken temple is said to be overrun by strange fish-like creatures.

Part IV
Part V
Part VI
Brokul has been defeated and now you can talk with Spectulus or Dedoras what you found about the fishmen.
Congratulations you completed this mission.

missions.name: Asuri - The Lament
steps: Go to Asuri Palace in Port Hope.
You were able to assemble an instrument with the objects found. That should work for something.
You must talk with the dead girl's mother, Gail, at Port Hope.

With a heavy heart you used a piece of ebony as well as the skull and hair of an unfortunate maiden to create a bone fiddle. By playing the Peacock Ballad you should be able to open the viollet portal.
You may enter the viollet portal. Check if there is something useful there.
In a secret room of the Asura Palace you discovered an old writing desk that contains an ancient map. This must be a hint to the secret library you are searching for.
Congratulations you completed this mission.

missions.name: The Order of the Falcon
steps: It is said that an ancient order of knights once resided in Edron. The knights disappeared a long time ago but their abandoned outpost is still there. The place may yet hold some surprises.
You defeated Grand Master Oberon in mortal combat. The Falcon Order may have lost its glory a long time ago but you are just getting started.
Congratulations you completed this mission.

missions.name: The Path of Defiances
steps: Go to Darashia and find out about the mysterious statue.
After you have been swallowed by a sand vortex you have entered a hidden desert area. A voice of unknown origin has informed you that you will have to face some challenges.
Part III
Part IV
Part V
Part VI
Part VII
You have found a book page in a chest. It seems to contain very useful information, but you are not capable to read it. At this point you have to speak with an expert.
Congratulations you completed this mission.

missions.name: Bursting at the Seams
steps: Dedoras told you where to search for leads to the Veiled Hoard: the museum in Thais, a fishmen temple in Tiquanda, an order fortress in Edron, the Asuri Palace and a deserted isle.
You talked with Gareth and now you may pass trougth the door.
Part III
Part IV
Part V
You successfully entered the Veiled Hoard of Zathroth. However, countless secret and vast knowledge still lie ahead.
You have reported Gareth about the enigmatic inscription you have found in the chamber of doom. He was able to decipher it for you and referred to Dedoras in Cormaya for further assistance.
Congratulations you completed this mission.

missions.name: A Djinn in Love
steps: You need to return to Marina and ask her for a date with Ocelus.
You need to return to Ocelus with the bad news.
Ocelus told you to get a poem for him, if you didn't buy one already, head to Ab'Dendriel and buy a Love Poem from Elvith.
You need to go recite the poem to Marina and impress her with the Djinn's romantic and poetic abilities.
After reciting the poem to Marina, she decided to date Ocelus and release Ray Striker from her spell.

missions.name: A Poem for the Mermaid
steps: You need to find the man-stealing mermaid and try to break her spell over poor Raymond, the mermaid Marina is near the northern coast of the island.
You discovered that she does in fact have a spell on him, and will not release him unless someone better comes along.
You are a true master in reciting love poems now. No mermaid will be able to resist if you ask for a date!

missions.name: Ray's Mission 1: Fafnar's Fire
steps: Ray Striker asked you to travel to Edron and pretend to the alchemist Sandra that you are the one whom the other pirates sent to get the fire. When she asks for a payment, tell her 'Your continued existence is payment enough'.
Sandra will be enraged and will cut any deals with pirates. Report back to Raymond Striker.
Ray Striker was pleased to hear about Sandra's rage. If you haven't done so yet, ask him for other missions.

missions.name: Ray's Mission 2: Sabotage
steps: Buy a fire bug at Liberty Bay and infiltrate Nargor. Find the pirates' harbor and use the fire bug to sabotage their catapult there.
You were able to sabotage the catapult in the pirate's harbor. Report back to Ray Striker to tell him about mission.
Ray Striker was pleased to hear about successful sabotage. If you haven't done so yet, ask him for other missions.

missions.name: Ray's Mission 3: Spy Mission
steps: Travel to Nargor and try to enter de pirate's tavern by deceiving the guard in front of it. Read all the plans which you can find in the tavern and report back to Striker.
You studied all of the pirate's plans in their tavern which will give insight about their next strikes. If you haven't done so yet, ask Ray for another mission.

missions.name: Ray's Mission 4: Proof of Death
steps: Travel to Nargor and try to find out more about the mission Klaus offers. He apparently wants the death of Ray Striker and your task is to convince him that Ray is dead.
Klaus told you to kill Ray Striker and bring him his lucky pillow as a proof. Ray should be interested in hearing about this mission.
You informed Ray that Klaus needs his lucky pillow as proof of his death. Ray gave it to you, now go convince Klaus that the mission is fulfilled and Ray is Dead!
Klaus belieaves that Ray Striker is dead and will celebrate a big party. You should tell Ray about your successful mission.
Ray was very impressed to hear about your successful mission and gave you a ship and a pirate outfit as reward.

missions.name: Reputation in Sabrehaven: Suspicious
steps: Ariella asked you for a few days of adequate supply. Help her and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
You have finished one mission. Ask around in Sabrehaven and surroundings whether the people there might have missions for you. This will improve your reputation and earn their trust.
Morgan asked you to deliver a letter safely to old Eremo on Cormaya. Help him and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
You delivered the letter safely to old Eremo. Report back to Morgan and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
You have finished two missions. Ask around in Sabrehaven and surroundings whether the people there might have missions for you. This will improve your reputation and earn their trust.
Duncan requested an atlas of the explorers society. Help him and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
You have finished three missions. Ask around in Sabrehaven and surroundings whether the people there might have missions for you. This will improve your reputation and earn their trust.
Chondur asked at least five pirate voodoo dolls to lift the curse. Help him and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
You have finished four missions. Ask around in Sabrehaven and surroundings whether the people there might have missions for you. This will improve your reputation and earn their trust.
Ariella asked you to bring a sample of whisper beer from a secret whisper bar in Carlin. Help her and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
Take the sample of whisper beer to Ariella. Help her and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.

missions.name: Reputation in Sabrehaven: Friendly
steps: You have finished five missions. People in Sabrehaven seem to start trusting you. Maybe this is a good time for some more difficult missions.
You have finished six missions. People in Sabrehaven seem to start trusting you. Maybe this is a good time for some more difficult missions.
You have finished seven missions. People in Sabrehaven seem to start trusting you. Maybe this is a good time for some more difficult missions.

missions.name: Reputation in Sabrehaven: Loyal
steps: You have finished nine missions. People in Sabrehaven are considering you as one of them.
You have finished all missions. People in Sabrehaven are considering you as one of them and you earned their full trust.

missions.name: The Counterspell
steps: You have begun Chondur's ritual. Bring him a fresh dead chicken so that he can begin to create a counterspell which will allow you to pass the magical barrier on Goroma.
You have begun Chondur's ritual. Bring him a fresh dead rat so that he can continue creating a counterspell which will allow you to pass the magical barrier on Goroma.
You have begun Chondur's ritual. Bring him a fresh dead black sheep so that he can complete his counterspell which will allow you to pass the magical barrier on Goroma.
You may pass the energy barrier on Goroma. The counterspell Chondur created for you with his ritual will allow you to withstand the evil magic of the cultist.

missions.name: The Errand
steps: You told Eleonore to run a small errand. Deliver the 200 gold pieces she gave to the herbalist Charlotta in the south-western part of Liberty Bay.
You delivered the gold to Charlotta. Return to Eleonore and tell her the secret password: peg leg

missions.name: The Governor's Daughter
steps: You promised to find Eleonore's lost ring. She told you that a parrot stole it from her dressing table and flew to the nearby mountains. You might need a rake to retrieve the ring.
You found the ring. Return it to Eleonore.
You returned the ring to Eleonore.

missions.name: Mission 2: Burglary
steps: Dorian wants you to steal a vase from Sarina, the owner of Carlin's general store.
You have stolen the vase, report back to Dorian!
You have delivered the stolen vase to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 3: Invitation
steps: Your task is to somehow convince Oswald to hand you an invitation to the king's ball.
You have received the invitation to the King's ball, report back to Dorian!
You have delivered the invitation to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 4: Bridge Robbery
steps: Dorian wants you to find a forger in the outlaw camp, go talk to Snake eye.
Snake Eye told you to visit Ahmet in Ankrahmun.
Ahmet told you that he will only help a friend and asked you to kill at least one Nomad.
You have killed a Nomad, go back to Ahmet!
You have received the forged documents from Ahmet, next is to get a disguise from Percybald in Venore!
You have received the dwarf disguise from Percybald. Now go do the deal with Nurik.
You have traded the forged documents for the painting, report back to Dorian.
You have delivered the painting to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 5: Enforcing Debts
steps: Your mission is to travel to Tiquanda. Fina a hidden smuggler cave to the north of Port Hope and try to retrieve the valuable goblet which Dorian is looking for. Once you got it, bring it to him.
You have delivered the golden goblet to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 6: Fishnapping
steps: Dorian wants you to fishnap Theodore Loveless' fish, first you need to get the key to his room. Talk to Chantalle in Liberty Bay.
You have received the key for Theodore Loveless' room, time to fishnap his fish!
You have fishnapped Theodore Loveless' fish, deliver it to Dorian.
You have delivered the fish to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 7: Blackmail
steps: Your current task is to find compromising information about one of the Venore city guards, no matter how. A good starting point might be in their barracks.
You have delivered the compromising letter to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!

missions.name: Mission 8: Message
steps: Dorian wants you to deliver a message to his competitors in the dark cathedral.
You have put up the message, report back to Dorian.
You have reported back that you have completed the mission, Dorian now allows you to trade with Black Bert.

missions.name: Mission 1: Trophy
steps: Your first mission for becoming a recognized trader is to bring the traveling salesman Rashid a Deer Trophy.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.

missions.name: Mission 2: Delivery
steps: Your mission is to get the package from Willard the weapon dealer at Edron.
Willard forgot to pick it up from Snake Eye at Outlaw Camp. So he wants you to go and pick it up from Snake Eye.
Take the package just next door.
Now bring back the package to Rashid.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.

missions.name: Mission 3: Cheese
steps: Rashid wants you to pick his special order from Miraia in Darashia. But you have to be quick, Scarab cheese can rot really fast in high temperature.
Now quickly bring back the Scarab cheese to Rashid.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.

missions.name: Mission 4: Vase
steps: Rashid have ordered a special elven vase from Briasol in Ab'Dendriel. He asks you to buy it from Briasol and bring it back. But you should be carefully, since the vase is very fragile.
Now carefully bring the vase back to Rashid.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.

missions.name: Mission 5: Make a deal
steps: This time, Rashid is testing your trading skills to buy a Crimson Sword from Uzgod. But it have to be less than 400 gold coins and the quality has to be perfect.
Now bring the sword back to Rashid.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.

missions.name: Mission 6: Goldfish
steps: Rashid wants you to bring him a Goldfish Bowl.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.

missions.name: Mission 7: Declare
steps: Rashid has declare you as one of his recognized traders, and now you are able to trade with him anytime..

missions.name: Troubled Animals
steps: You met the talking white deer Alkestios. It turned out he is actually a fae - and needs help. Search out a poacher camp north of the Green Claw Swamps and keep the poachers from hunting white deers.
You found a book with legends in the poacher camp. You asked Ahmed to add a story about how it brings ill luck to kill a white deer, hopefully the poachers will desist from hunting Alkestios.
You returned to the poacher camp and placed the faked book noticeably on a table. You're quite sure the poachers will discover it soon and desist from hunting Alkestios.
Alkestios asked you for help on another issue. There seemms to be a problem with a wolf mother and her whelps. Find the snake Ikassis in the north-west of Edron and talk to her, she knows more.
The snake Ikassis asked you to find a female wolf in the south of Cormaya. The animal is in need of help, yet Ikassis didn't know any details.
You found the ghostly wolf and promised to search for her lost whelps. The wolf told you to start your search at Ulderek's Rock
At Ulderek's Rock you found a sleeping war wolf. It might actually be the now grown up whelp you were looking for. The skeleton nearby implies that the hunter didn't survive his misdeed.
You talked to Irmana in Venore and she gave you the fur of one of the wolf whelps you're searching for. You should talk to their mother's ghost.
As the ghostly wolf asked you, you placed the whelp fur in the mouth of a nearby stone, that is shaped like a big face.
You redeemed the ghostly wolf. You should return to Ikassis and tell her about it.
Ikassis was happy to hear that you redeemed the ghostly wolf. But she asked you to help someone else: one of her sisters. You can find her in the guise of swan at a river sourth-east of Ikassis.
You met a swan that in truth is a swan maiden, a kind of fae. These fae have magical cloaks that allow them to shape change between swan and girl. Find this maiden's cloak that was stolen by a troll.
The troll Grarkharok sold the cloak to Tereban and he lost it during a flight with magic carpet. The cloak's feathers are now scattered along the carpet's beeline between Edron and Darashia.
You found many swan feathers on Edron and in Darama desert. Now you should have enough for an entire cloak. You should talk to the swan maiden.
You found enough magical swan feathers. The swan maiden will now be able to restore her cloak. You should talk to Alkestios again.
Alkestios was very happy about your support. You earned the Fae's trust and may now enter their secret realm. Search for an elemental shrine of ice, fire, earth or energy to reach Feyrist.

missions.name: Nightmare Intruders
steps: You killed 200 of the nightmare monsters that are invading Feyrist. Maelyrra was very happy but it seems she still has other problems. She may need your help once more.
Maelyrra asked you to retrieve an artefact for her: the moon mirror. It was stolen by the tainted fae who inhabit the caves underneath Feyrist. She also asked you to free some captured fairies.
You found the moon mirror and freed the captured fairies. Maelyrra was very happy but it seems she has another problem. Perhaps you should offer your assistance once more.
The barrier that protects Feyrist from the outside world is weakened. To strengthen it again you need to find the starlight vial and the sun catcher. Ask Aurita and Taegen for these items.
Gather sunlight, starlight and moon rays. You have to do this with the sun catcher on the beach, with the starlight vial high in the mountains and with the moon mirror on a glade in the forest.
You may now repair the barrier. Charge the five moon sculptures of Feyrist with moon rays, the five dreambird trees with starlight and the five sun mosics with sunlight.
You repaired tha magical barrier that protects Feyrist from the outside world. The fae's secret realm is safe again.

missions.name: An Unlikely Couple
steps: Help Aurita and Taegen and find a spell to transform Aurita's fishtail into legs temporarily. A fairy in a small fae village in the southwest of Feyrist might know more.
You have succesfully created the magical music notes for the mermaid Aurita. Talk to the faun Taegen, he also needs your help.
The faun Taegen wants to spend some time with his lover, the mermaid Aurita. He wants to visit her home and thus must be able to breath under water. Therefore he needs the rare raven herb.
You found the rare raven herb and gave it to Taegen. Now he will create a sun catcher for you. You may also ask Aurita for the starlight vial now.

quests.location: Fields of Glory, Poacher Caves, Edron, Cormaya, Ulderek's Rock, Venore, Darashia, the Devourer, Feyrist, Candia, and more
quests.reward: Access to Feyrist, Butterfly Ring, 5 Ancient Coins, 5 Rainbow Quartzes, Blossom Bag, Sun Catcher, Moon Mirror, Starlight Vial and Swan Feather Cloak
